name: Canvas Write
description: Put a result on a canvas as a new layer. The canvas is not edited: a new revision is made from the one Canvas Region read, and the head moves to it only when nothing else moved it meanwhile. When something did, the new revision stays as a candidate and the node reports it (accepted is off, a warning is shown), and nothing is lost: the head is the other change. With Keep as candidate on, the head never moves: the result waits as a candidate for you to compare and accept or drop (fugue canvas candidates, diff, accept, drop). The picture is resized to the stitch's box and the new layer holds it whole, with a layer mask that blends it in: the mask softened outward by Blend pixels, as Stitch does (turn Bake the blend on to put the blend into the layer's own pixels instead, as before). The layer is named from the prompt that made the picture, else Fill 1, Fill 2 and so on.

inputs.name: canvas
inputs.label: Canvas
inputs.description: The canvas and the revision the work started from: Canvas Region's canvas output.

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.description: The picture to place. With a stitch it must have the region's shape to within 2%; without one it covers the whole canvas.

inputs.name: stitch
inputs.label: Stitch
inputs.description: Where the picture goes, and the mask to blend through: Canvas Region's stitch output.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.description: The mask to blend through, at the canvas's size. Without one, the stitch's, and without a stitch the whole picture.

inputs.name: blend
inputs.label: Blend
inputs.description: How far the edge of the mask fades outward, in canvas pixels.

inputs.name: candidate
inputs.label: Keep as candidate
inputs.description: Keep the result for review: the head does not move, and the new revision waits as a candidate to accept into the head or drop.

inputs.name: bake
inputs.label: Bake the blend into the layer
inputs.description: Off: the layer is the redrawn picture whole and the blend is its layer mask, which can be turned off or edited later. On: the blend is put into the layer's pixels and there is no layer mask (the composite is the same).

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Layer name
inputs.description: The new layer's name. Fill (the default) or empty names it from the prompt upstream (the Text Encode that made the picture), else Fill 1, Fill 2 and so on.

outputs.name: accepted
outputs.label: Accepted
outputs.description: Whether the head moved to the new revision.

outputs.name: head
outputs.label: Head
outputs.description: The canvas's head after the write: the new revision when accepted, else the revision that got there first.
